description: LM741 single op-amp (TI uA741 1989 macromodel; the same part, second-sourced)

source.licence: KiCad-Spice-Library collection (GPL-3.0); model by the manufacturer named, redistributed there

note: The card clips 2.0 V from each rail, about a volt sooner than a typical part (still inside the sheet's minimum). Bias & headroom uses the sheet's typical swing, so a render can clip about a volt before the pane's limit.

rating_sources.vs_max: TI LM741 datasheet SNOSC25D (rev. Oct 2015): vs_max from 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings (LM741C ±18 V); common-mode headroom from 6.7, LM741C input voltage range ±12 V min at ±15 V
rating_sources.cm_neg_headroom: TI LM741 datasheet SNOSC25D (rev. Oct 2015): vs_max from 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings (LM741C ±18 V); common-mode headroom from 6.7, LM741C input voltage range ±12 V min at ±15 V
rating_sources.cm_pos_headroom: TI LM741 datasheet SNOSC25D (rev. Oct 2015): vs_max from 6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings (LM741C ±18 V); common-mode headroom from 6.7, LM741C input voltage range ±12 V min at ±15 V
rating_sources.out_neg_headroom: TI LM741 datasheet SNOSC25D: output headroom from Electrical Characteristics (LM741), output voltage swing ±14 V typ at RL ≥ 10 kΩ, VS = ±15 V (±12 V min)
rating_sources.out_pos_headroom: TI LM741 datasheet SNOSC25D: output headroom from Electrical Characteristics (LM741), output voltage swing ±14 V typ at RL ≥ 10 kΩ, VS = ±15 V (±12 V min)

package.name: 8-pin DIP
package.source: TI LM741 datasheet SNOSC25D (rev. Oct 2015), Pin Functions (8-pin PDIP); the same pins as TI's uA741 sheet SLOS094H, Table 4-1

datasheet.note: LM741C large signal voltage gain 20 V/mV min, 200 V/mV typ, ±15 V, RL ≥ 2 kΩ (6.7)
the LM741A's bandwidth (6.6: 0.437 MHz min, 1.5 MHz typ); the LM741C table gives none
